# dsh-hold-to-talk-plus
**Hold-to-talk voice input for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web composer — now with third-party ASR, a
user wordbank, draft-as-context prompting, a settings page and live preview.**
Hold the mouse on the composer, speak, release: the transcript drops into your draft. The gesture, t
he floating overlay, the "slide up to cancel" interaction and the 60 s auto-finalize are unchanged f
rom upstream; everything below is what this fork adds.
> 中文详细文档见 README.zh.md。
## Features
| Feature | Upstream `dsh-hold-to-talk@0.1.4` | This fork |

| Local offline ASR (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx) | ✅ | ✅ |
| Third-party cloud ASR (OpenAI-compatibl

e `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, or Alibaba BaiLian `chat/completions` + `input_audio`) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Aut

o-detect protocol from endpoint URL (no more 400 on mismatch) | ❌ | ✅ |
| User wordbank (glossary +

`correct=wrong1\|wrong2` correction rules) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Composer draft sent as context prompt | ❌ | ✅

|
| Settings page (`Settings → Voice input`) with provider presets and guided API-key acquisition |

❌ | ✅ |
| Connection test without saving (401/403/404/429/timeout translated to plain language) | ❌

| ✅ |
| Live preview while speaking on cloud ASR (re-decode of the tail window every 2 s) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Automatic fallback to local ASR when the cloud call fails | ❌ | ✅ |
## Install (as a DSH profile plugin)
This repo is a drop-in replacement for `dsh-hold-to-talk`, so it keeps the same package name and bun
po is a drop-in replacement for `dsh-hold-to-talk`, so it keeps the same package name and bundle id.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then open **Settings → Voice input**, pick a provider, paste an API key, hit **Test connection**, sa
n open **Settings → Voice input**, pick a provider, paste an API key, hit **Test connection**, save.
## Providers
| Provider | Endpoint | Model | Protocol |
| Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (BaiLian) | `https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/com

pletions` | `qwen3-asr-flash` | `chat-audio` |
| SiliconFlow (free tier) | `https://api.siliconflow.

cn/v1/audio/transcriptions` | `TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR` | `transcriptions` |
| Self-hosted (faster-whis
per / whisper.cpp / FunASR gateway) | `http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions` | `whisper-lar

ge-v3` | `transcriptions` |
| Local offline (no key) | — | SenseVoiceSmall int8 | `local` |
> Note: on BaiLian's compatible endpoint the ASR task **ignores instruction-style prompts**; the glo
ssary is accepted but has limited effect. Reliable term correction comes from the wordbank's `correc
t=wrong` rules, which apply to both local and cloud results.
